g09_nominalisation.title: 9. Nominalisation र Academic Density
blocks: Verb/adjective-लाई noun-मा बदल्ने तरिका, जसले academic register-लाई चिनाउँछ; Task 2-का लागि वाक्य फेरि बनाउने ३ वटा तरिका; cohesion device-को रूपमा nominalisation; र धेरै nominalisation गरेर लेखाइलाई कुहिरोजस्तो धमिलो नबनाउने अनुशासन।

Nominalisation भनेको verb वा adjective-लाई noun-मा बदल्नु हो, र यो formal academic English-को सबैभन्दा मुख्य विशेषता हो। दैनिक बोलीचालीमा “the government decided to act, and this reduced pollution,” भनिन्छ भने academic लेखाइमा “the government's decision to act led to a reduction in pollution.” भनिन्छ। जानकारी उस्तै छ; register चाहिँ बदलिएको छ। Nominalisation-ले तपाईंलाई कम शब्दमा धेरै अर्थ राख्न, idea-हरूलाई सहज रूपमा जोड्न, र examiner-हरूले सबैभन्दा माथिल्लो band-सँग जोड्ने व्यक्तिगत नभएको, विचारमा केन्द्रित स्वर अपनाउन मद्दत गर्छ।

Nominalisation-ले काम जनाउने शब्द (verb) वा गुण जनाउने शब्द (adjective) लाई वस्तु जनाउने शब्द (noun) मा बदल्छ। कुनै idea एक पटक noun बनेपछि त्यो वाक्यको subject बन्न सक्छ - र यही कुराले academic लेखाइलाई अमूर्त, विचारमा आधारित अनुभूति दिन्छ।
हेर्नुहोस्, एउटै idea कसरी verb-मा आधारित (व्यक्तिगत, धेरै शब्द भएको) form-बाट noun-मा आधारित (व्यक्तिगत नभएको, कसिलो) form-मा जान्छ।
Because the company expanded quickly, it became difficult to manage.
The company's rapid expansion led to management difficulties.
“expanded” “expansion” बन्छ, “difficult to manage” “management difficulties” बन्छ; वाक्य छोटो र बढी formal हुन्छ।
The government decided to invest in schools, and this improved literacy.
The government's decision to invest in schools improved literacy.
पूरै पहिलो clause एउटा noun phrase-मा खुम्चिन्छ, जसले subject-को काम गर्न सक्छ।
तरिका ३ चरणको छ, जुन तपाईं जुनसुकै बेला प्रयोग गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ: काम वा गुण पत्ता लगाउनुहोस्; त्यसलाई त्यसको noun-मा बदल्नुहोस्; त्यही noun-लाई subject वा object बनाएर वाक्य फेरि बनाउनुहोस्।
9.3 Task 2-का लागि वाक्य फेरि बनाउने ३ वटा तरिका
“because” clause-लाई noun subject-मा बदल्नुहोस्। “Because pollution increased, health worsened” → “The increase in pollution worsened public health.”
सहज रूपमा जोड्न पूरै घटनालाई अर्को वाक्यको subject बनाउनुहोस्। “The factory closed. This caused unemployment.” → “The closure of the factory caused widespread unemployment.”
“X is important / X is able to”-को सट्टा एउटा noun राख्नुहोस्। “It is important to reduce waste” → “The reduction of waste is a priority.”

यो दोस्रो तरिका (घटना → subject) एउटा cohesion device पनि हो: अघिल्लो idea-लाई एउटा noun-ले नाम दिनु (“this closure,” “such growth,” “this development”) “moreover” जस्ता सस्ता connector बिना paragraph-हरू जोड्ने एउटा परिष्कृत तरिका हो।
धेरै nominalisation गरेर लेखाइलाई कुहिरोजस्तो धमिलो नबनाउनुहोस्

Nominalisation शक्तिशाली छ, तर यसको बिग्रने पाटो पनि साँचो हो: abstract noun-ले भरिएको वाक्य भारी, नीरस र पढ्न गाह्रो हुन्छ। Band 9-को सीप भनेको सन्तुलन हो - nominalisation-ले register माथि लैजाने, तर वाक्यलाई स्पष्ट राख्ने। २ वटा समस्या बारम्बार देखिन्छन्।

समस्या १ · Noun-को लहर। धेरै abstract noun-लाई “of”-ले एकपछि अर्को जोड्दा पढ्नै नसकिने थुप्रो बन्छ।
✗ The implementation of the reduction of the consumption of energy is a necessity.
✓ Reducing energy consumption is essential.

समस्या २ · काम गर्ने को हो भन्ने पूरै हराउनु। कहिलेकाहीँ पाठकलाई कसले काम गर्‍यो भनेर थाहा हुनुपर्छ; पूरै nominalisation गर्दा जिम्मेवारी बेकारमा लुक्न सक्छ।
✗ A decision was reached and an implementation followed.
✓ The committee decided to act and then implemented the plan.

Nominalisation सबैभन्दा स्पष्ट विशेषताहरूमध्ये एक हो, जसले Band 6.5 script (जुन होसियारीसाथ बोलेको कुराजस्तो पढिन्छ) लाई Band 8 script (जुन academic लेखाइजस्तो पढिन्छ) बाट छुट्याउँछ। यसका २ वटा फाइदा सिधै marking criteria-सँग मिल्छन्: यसले Lexical Resource बढाउँछ, किनकि यसले तपाईंलाई सटीक, formal शब्द छान्न बाध्य बनाउँछ; र यसले Coherence and Cohesion बढाउँछ, किनकि अघिल्लो idea-लाई noun-ले नाम दिँदा वाक्यहरू सुन्दर तरिकाले जोडिन्छन्। निर्देशन यो हो: यसलाई सोचेर आफ्ना topic sentence र transition-हरूमा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्, जहाँ कसिलोपन र formality सबैभन्दा महत्त्वपूर्ण हुन्छ, तर व्याख्या गर्ने वाक्यहरूलाई स्पष्ट राख्नुहोस्।

कुन skill-मा काम लाग्छ: Writing
Task 2 topic sentence: The rapid urbanisation of developing nations has placed enormous pressure on public infrastructure.
Task 2 cohesion (event → subject): This expansion, however, has come at a significant environmental cost.
Task 1 summary: The overall growth in exports was matched by a comparable rise in imports.
Chapter 9, र Module 3 यहीँ सकियो। अब Module 4 (The Full Workbook), Chapter 10 आउँछ: पूरा essay editing र speaking transcript-लाई चिटिक्क बनाउने काम, त्यसपछि Chapter 11-मा सबै answer key।

g09_nominalisation_practice.title: 9. Practice · Nominalisation र Academic Density
blocks: Nominalisation-ले verb वा adjective-लाई noun-मा बदल्छ -- decide decision बन्छ, difficult difficulty बन्छ। कुनै idea एक पटक noun बनेपछि त्यो वाक्यको subject बन्न सक्छ, र ठ्याक्कै यही कुराले academic लेखाइलाई अमूर्त, विचारमा आधारित अनुभूति दिन्छ।
**किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ:** बोलचालको English र academic English बीचको फरकका लागि सबैभन्दा बढी जिम्मेवार एउटै grammatical बानी nominalisation हो।
Nominalisation-ले काम जनाउने शब्द (verb) वा गुण जनाउने शब्द (adjective) लाई वस्तु जनाउने शब्द (noun) मा बदल्छ। कुनै idea एक पटक noun बनेपछि त्यो वाक्यको **subject** बन्न सक्छ।

यी family-हरूलाई दुवै दिशाबाट अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् -- verb form चिन्ने र भन्नेबित्तिकै noun form बनाउने। यसैले गर्दा exam-को दबाबमा पनि nominalisation तपाईंको हातमा हुन्छ, पढ्दा मात्र चिन्ने कुरा बनेर बस्दैन।

blocks.title: Exercise 9.1 · Nominalisation अभ्यास
blocks.instructions: कोष्ठकमा दिइएको शब्दलाई nominalise गरेर हरेक वाक्यलाई अझ academic register-मा फेरि लेख्नुहोस्, र बनेको noun-लाई subject वा object बनाउनुहोस्। एउटा item-मा धेरै nominalise गरिएको लहरलाई सजिलो बनाउन भनिएको छ।

items.prompt: The company expanded rapidly, and this created management problems. (nominalise “expanded”)
items.answer: The company's rapid expansion created management problems.
accepted: The company's rapid expansion created management problems.

items.prompt: Because the population grew, the demand for housing rose. (nominalise “grew”)
items.answer: The growth of the population raised the demand for housing.
accepted: The growth of the population raised the demand for housing.
Population growth raised the demand for housing.

items.prompt: The factory closed, which caused widespread unemployment. (nominalise “closed”)
items.answer: The closure of the factory caused widespread unemployment.
accepted: The closure of the factory caused widespread unemployment.

items.prompt: It is important to reduce waste. (nominalise “reduce” and “important”)
items.answer: The reduction of waste is a priority.
accepted: The reduction of waste is a priority.
Waste reduction is important.

items.prompt: The government decided to invest in railways, and this improved transport. (nominalise “decided”)
items.answer: The government's decision to invest in railways improved transport.
accepted: The government's decision to invest in railways improved transport.

items.prompt: Because energy is consumed at a high rate, emissions have risen. (nominalise “consumed”)
items.answer: The high consumption of energy has raised emissions.
accepted: The high consumption of energy has raised emissions.
High energy consumption has raised emissions.

items.prompt: The team failed to plan properly, which led to delays. (nominalise “failed”)
items.answer: The team's failure to plan properly led to delays.
accepted: The team's failure to plan properly led to delays.

items.prompt: Many species have become extinct, and this worries scientists. (nominalise “become extinct”)
items.answer: The extinction of many species worries scientists.
accepted: The extinction of many species worries scientists.

items.prompt: The city developed quickly, and this attracted investors. (nominalise “developed”)
items.answer: The city's rapid development attracted investors.
accepted: The city's rapid development attracted investors.

items.prompt: Prices increased sharply, which reduced consumer spending. (nominalise “increased”)
items.answer: The sharp increase in prices reduced consumer spending.
accepted: The sharp increase in prices reduced consumer spending.

items.prompt: People are more aware of climate change, and this has changed behaviour. (nominalise “aware”)
items.answer: Growing awareness of climate change has changed behaviour.
accepted: Growing awareness of climate change has changed behaviour.

items.prompt: The two countries cooperated, and trade improved. (nominalise “cooperated”)
items.answer: Cooperation between the two countries improved trade.
accepted: Cooperation between the two countries improved trade.

items.prompt: Simplify the noun string: The implementation of the reduction of the consumption of energy is a necessity.
items.answer: Reducing energy consumption is essential.
accepted: Reducing energy consumption is essential.
Cutting energy consumption is essential.
items.reason: “of”-को थुप्रोलाई तोडेर फेरि स्पष्ट form-मा ल्याउनुहोस्।

items.prompt: The scientists analysed the data carefully, and this revealed a pattern. (nominalise “analysed”)
items.answer: The scientists' careful analysis of the data revealed a pattern.
accepted: The scientists' careful analysis of the data revealed a pattern.

items.prompt: Because the roads were poor, transport costs were high. (nominalise “poor”)
items.answer: The poor condition of the roads raised transport costs.
accepted: The poor condition of the roads raised transport costs.
The poor state of the roads raised transport costs.

blocks.title: Exercise 9.2 · वाक्य फेरि बनाउने र कुहिरो हटाउने
blocks.instructions: Chapter 9 पूरा गर्न थपिएको (बाँकी हरेक chapter-मा २ वटा exercise छन्)। Item 1–6: 9.3-को जुन तरिका कोष्ठकमा दिइएको छ, त्यही प्रयोग गरेर हरेक वाक्य फेरि लेख्नुहोस्। Item 7–10: हरेक वाक्यमा धेरै nominalisation गरिएको छ; “Do not over-nominalise into fog” box-मा देखाइएजस्तै, वाक्य formal नै रहोस् तर स्पष्ट पढियोस् भन्ने गरी फेरि लेख्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: Because traffic increased, air quality in the city declined. (move 1: “because” clause → noun subject)
items.answer: The increase in traffic caused a decline in air quality in the city.
accepted: The increase in traffic caused a decline in air quality in the city.
The increase in traffic led to a decline in the city's air quality.
Increased traffic caused a decline in air quality in the city.
items.reason: “because” clause noun subject “the increase in traffic” बन्छ; “declined” “a decline in” बन्छ।

items.prompt: Because the region became poorer, crime rose sharply. (move 1)
items.answer: The region's growing poverty led to a sharp rise in crime.
accepted: The region's growing poverty led to a sharp rise in crime.
Growing poverty in the region led to a sharp rise in crime.
The increase in poverty in the region caused a sharp rise in crime.
items.reason: “became poorer” → “poverty” (adjective poor → noun poverty, 9.1-को table-मा जस्तै); “rose” → “a rise in”।

items.prompt: The government banned plastic bags. This reduced litter on beaches. (move 2: event → subject of the next sentence)
items.answer: The government's ban on plastic bags reduced litter on beaches.
accepted: The government's ban on plastic bags reduced litter on beaches.
The ban on plastic bags reduced litter on beaches.
items.reason: पहिलो वाक्य खुम्चिएर noun phrase “the ban on plastic bags” बन्छ, जुन subject हुन्छ।

items.prompt: Many young people migrated to cities. This weakened rural communities. (move 2)
items.answer: The migration of young people to cities weakened rural communities.
accepted: The migration of young people to cities weakened rural communities.
The large-scale migration of young people to cities weakened rural communities.
items.reason: “migrated” → “the migration of”; पूरै घटना अब subject हो।

items.prompt: It is important to protect endangered species. (move 3: “It is important to …” → noun)
items.answer: The protection of endangered species is a priority.
accepted: The protection of endangered species is a priority.
The protection of endangered species is essential.
Protecting endangered species is a priority.
items.reason: “to protect” → “the protection of”, र अस्पष्ट “important” एउटा सटीक noun complement (“a priority”) बन्छ।

items.prompt: Many students are not able to afford university fees. (move 3: “be able to” → noun)
items.answer: Many students lack the ability to afford university fees.
accepted: Many students lack the ability to afford university fees.
The inability of many students to afford university fees is a concern.
Many students' inability to afford university fees is a concern.
items.reason: “are not able to” → “lack the ability to” / “inability” (able → ability, 9.1-को table-मा जस्तै)।

items.prompt: The implementation of the improvement of the quality of the provision of education is required.
items.answer: Improving the quality of education is necessary.
accepted: Improving the quality of education is necessary.
The quality of education needs to be improved.
Educational quality must be improved.
items.reason: ४ वटा “of” phrase भएको noun-को लहर पढ्नै सकिँदैन; एउटा बलियो idea (quality of education) राख्नुहोस् र कामका लागि verb form प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: The reduction of the consumption of water by the population of the city is a necessity.
items.answer: The city's population needs to reduce its water consumption.
accepted: The city's population needs to reduce its water consumption.
Reducing water consumption in the city is necessary.
The city needs to reduce its water consumption.
items.reason: थुप्रिएका noun-मध्ये एउटालाई फेरि verb-मा फर्काउनुहोस् (reduction → reduce) र “of the population of the city”-को सट्टा possessive प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: There was an expansion in the utilisation of the internet by the elderly for the purpose of communication.
items.answer: Older people increasingly use the internet to communicate.
accepted: Older people increasingly use the internet to communicate.
Internet use among older people for communication has expanded.
More elderly people now use the internet to communicate.
items.reason: “utilisation” “use”-को लागि फुलाइएको noun हो, र “for the purpose of communication” “to communicate”-को सट्टामा आएको कुहिरो हो; formal भनेको धेरै शब्द भएको होइन।

items.prompt: The occurrence of the failure of the system was a consequence of the lack of maintenance.
items.answer: The system failed because of a lack of maintenance.
accepted: The system failed because of a lack of maintenance.
The system's failure was caused by a lack of maintenance.
A lack of maintenance caused the system to fail.
items.reason: “The occurrence of the failure”-ले केही थप्दैन; बढीमा एउटा nominalisation (failure वा lack) राख्नुहोस्, र कारणलाई स्पष्ट verb-ले बोक्न दिनुहोस्।

g10_editing.title: 10. सम्पूर्ण Essay Editing र Speaking Transcript Polish
blocks: परीक्षाको अवस्थामा integrated self-editing: ६ वटा pass भएको checklist, धेरै गल्ती भएकोदेखि थोरै गल्ती भएकोसम्मको क्रममा मिलाइएका ५ वटा पूरा essay सच्याउने काम, र ५ वटा spoken answer-लाई scripted नसुनिने गरी एक band माथि उठाउने अभ्यास।

अहिलेसम्म हरेक अध्यायमा तपाईंले एक पटकमा एउटै प्रकारको गल्ती सच्याउनुभयो, र के खोज्ने भनेर पहिले नै थाहा थियो। साँच्चैको परीक्षा त्यस्तो हुँदैन। साँच्चैको essay-मा मोड्युल १ देखि ३ सम्मका सबै नियम एकैसाथ लागू हुन्छन्, गल्तीहरू मिसिएका हुन्छन्, कुनै label हुँदैन, र छेउमा answer key नभई समयको दबाबमा आफ्नो गल्ती आफैँ समात्नुपर्छ। यो अन्तिम module-ले ठ्याक्कै त्यही सीप सिकाउँछ: integrated self-editing। तपाईंले सबै प्रकारका गल्ती भएका पूरा essay सच्याउनुहुनेछ, अनि साँच्चैका spoken answer-लाई safe-but-basic बाट controlled-and-flexible स्तरमा उठाउनुहुनेछ।
10.1 यो workbook अध्याय कसरी प्रयोग गर्ने

तलका हरेक editing task एउटा पूरा, गल्ती भएको essay वा paragraph हो - लगभग Band 5.5 देखि 6.0 स्तरको लेखाइ, जसमा तपाईंले पढिसकेका खास प्रकारका गल्तीहरू राखिएका छन्। “गलत जस्तो देखिने कुरा” खोज्न जथाभावी नपढ्नुहोस्; एउटा अनुशासित क्रममा काम गर्नुहोस्।
Agreement pass: हरेक verb-लाई त्यसको वास्तविक subject-सँग मिलाएर जाँच्नुहोस् (अध्याय १)।
Tense pass: हरेक time frame सही र एकनास छ कि छैन जाँच्नुहोस् (अध्याय २)।
Article pass: हरेक singular noun-को अगाडि a / an / the / zero ठीक छ कि छैन जाँच्नुहोस् (अध्याय ३)।
Preposition pass: dependent preposition र data preposition-हरू जाँच्नुहोस् (अध्याय ४)।
Structure pass: fragment, run-on र comma splice छन् कि छैनन् जाँच्नुहोस्; विभिन्न किसिमका complex sentence छन् कि छैनन् हेर्नुहोस् (अध्याय ५)।
Range pass: मिल्ने ठाउँमा कम्तीमा एउटा passive, एउटा conditional र केही hedging छ कि (अध्याय ६, ७)? एउटा शुद्ध high-band structure छ कि (अध्याय ८, ९)?
हरेक item-का लागि छुट्टै pass गर्नुहोस्। एकै पटक पढेर सबै समात्न खोज्दा नै गल्ती छुट्छ; proofreading-मा specialist-ले generalist-लाई जित्छ।

यो अध्यायको exercise-मा ५ वटा editing essay छन्, धेरै गल्ती भएको (Essay 1) देखि थोरै गल्ती भएको (Essay 5) सम्मको क्रममा। हरेकसँग सच्याइएको model version र प्रकार अनुसार गल्तीहरूको विश्लेषण छ, ताकि तपाईंका ६ वटा pass मध्ये कुनले कुन गल्ती समात्थ्यो भनेर देख्न सक्नुहुन्छ। क्रमैसँग गर्नुहोस्; पछिका essay-हरूले तपाईंले अघिल्ला सुधारहरू राम्ररी आत्मसात गरिसक्नुभएको छ भन्ने मान्छन्।

तपाईं essay-लाई आफ्नै शैलीमा फेरि लेख्दै हुनुहुन्न। लेखकको अर्थ जोगाउँदै शुद्धता र range-का लागि चाहिने न्यूनतम सुधार मात्र गर्दै हुनुहुन्छ। परीक्षाको अन्तिम पाँच मिनेटमा आफ्नै लेखाइमा पनि ठ्याक्कै यही गर्नुपर्छ।

Speaking-मा पनि grammar-को मूल्याङ्कन हुन्छ, उही Grammatical Range and Accuracy शीर्षकमा, तर लक्ष्य फरक हुन्छ: Speaking-मा real time-मा नियन्त्रित लचकता (controlled flexibility) चाहिन्छ, लेखाइ जस्तो बाक्लो संरचना (written density) होइन। Exercise-का ५ वटा speaking item-मा एउटा साँच्चैको, basic-but-safe spoken answer दिइएको छ; यो कोर्सले सिकाएका move-हरू मात्र थपेर, scripted नसुनिने गरी, त्यसलाई एक band माथि उठाउनुपर्छ।
Speaking-का लागि upgrade toolkit, महत्त्वको क्रममा:
पहिले आधारभूत शुद्धता ठीक गर्नुहोस्: agreement, tense र article, किनभने यिनैमा सबैभन्दा धेरै अंक काटिन्छ।
एउटा complex sentence थप्नुहोस्: दुई वटा विचार जोड्न एउटा because, although वा which clause।
एउटा tense contrast थप्नुहोस्: range देखाउन past, present र future बीच आवतजावत गर्नुहोस् (“I used to … but now I … and I think I'll …”)।
एउटा hedging phrase थप्नुहोस्: “it depends,” “I'd say,” “on the whole,” “tend to”।
चाहनुहुन्छ भने, जोड दिन एउटा स्वाभाविक cleft: “what I really enjoy is …”
लक्ष्य शुद्ध र लचिलो spoken English हो, घोकेको paragraph होइन। Part 2 answer-मा एउटा स्वाभाविक complex sentence र एउटा tense contrast-ले तपाईंको score-का लागि घोकेको idiom भन्दा धेरै काम गर्छ।
किन integrated editing नै परीक्षाको असली सीप हो

दुवै writing task-को अन्त्यमा केही मिनेट editing-मा खर्च गर्नुपर्छ। व्यवस्थित रूपमा edit गर्ने परीक्षार्थीले edit नगर्नेहरूभन्दा Grammatical Range and Accuracy-मा प्रायः आधा band बढी पाउँछन्, किनभने उस्तै slip-हरू (छुटेको -s, छुटेको article, if-clause-मा will) धेरै सामान्य पनि छन् र लक्ष्य गरेर गरिएको pass-मा सजिलै समातिन्छन् पनि। Speaking-मा सहज रूपमा self-correct गर्न सक्नु (“the number of people were, sorry, was rising”) आफैँमा नियन्त्रणको सकारात्मक संकेत हो। यो अध्यायले त्यो बानी बसाल्छ, जसले तपाईंले सिकेका सबै कुरालाई परीक्षाको अवस्थामा अंकमा बदल्छ।

**किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ:** यो checklist-ले अघिल्ला सबै अध्यायलाई एउटै, बारम्बार दोहोर्याउन सकिने editing routine-मा बाँध्छ, जुन तपाईंले कुनै पनि essay बुझाउनुअघि चलाउन सक्नुहुन्छ।
1. **Agreement pass** -- हरेक verb-लाई त्यसको वास्तविक subject-सँग मिलाएर जाँच्नुहोस् (अध्याय १)।

3. **Article pass** -- हरेक singular noun-को अगाडि a/an/the/zero ठीक छ कि छैन जाँच्नुहोस् (अध्याय ३)।
4. **Preposition pass** -- dependent preposition र data preposition-हरू जाँच्नुहोस् (अध्याय ४)।

blocks.title: Exercise 10.1 · सम्पूर्ण Essay Editing
blocks.instructions: ५ वटा गल्ती भएका essay, धेरै गल्तीदेखि थोरै गल्तीसम्मको क्रममा। हरेकमा ६-pass checklist चलाउनुहोस् र लेखकको अर्थ जोगाउँदै सही रूपमा फेरि लेख्नुहोस्। Essay 5 मा एउटा high-band structure थप्न पनि भनिएको छ।

items.prompt: EDIT ESSAY 1 (heavily flawed). Correct every error, preserving the meaning. “In many country, the number of student who go abroad for study have increased in recent years. This trend have both advantage and disadvantage. On one hand, student who studies in foreign university gets access to better facility and they can learns new culture. On other hand, it is very expensive and many family cannot affords it. In my opinion, if government will provide more scholarship, this problem can be solved. According to me, the advantage is more than the disadvantage.”
items.answer: In many countries, the number of students who go abroad to study has increased in recent years. This trend has both advantages and disadvantages. On the one hand, students who study at foreign universities gain access to better facilities and can learn about new cultures. On the other hand, it is very expensive, and many families cannot afford it. In my opinion, if the government provided more scholarships, this problem could be solved. Overall, I believe the advantages outweigh the disadvantages.
accepted: In many countries, the number of students who go abroad to study has increased in recent years. This trend has both advantages and disadvantages. On the one hand, students who study at foreign universities gain access to better facilities and can learn about new cultures. On the other hand, it is very expensive, and many families cannot afford it. In my opinion, if the government provided more scholarships, this problem could be solved. Overall, I believe the advantages outweigh the disadvantages.
items.reason: Agreement: country→countries, student→students, have→has (the number singular हो), studies→study, gets→gain, learns→learn, affords→afford। Article: on the one hand, on the other hand, the government। Conditional: “if government will provide”→“if the government provided … could be solved” (if-clause-मा will आउँदैन)। Register: “According to me”→“Overall / In my view”; “advantage is more than”→“advantages outweigh the disadvantages”।

items.prompt: EDIT ESSAY 2. Correct every error. “Nowadays, technology have changed the way we communicate. In the past, people was writing letters which take many days to arrive. But now, we can sends a message in a second. Although this is convenient, but it also have some negative effect. For example, many young people spends too much time on their phone and they forgets how to talk face to face. If this trend continue, our social skill will became weaker.”
items.answer: Nowadays, technology has changed the way we communicate. In the past, people wrote letters, which took many days to arrive. Now, however, we can send a message in a second. Although this is convenient, it also has some negative effects. For example, many young people spend too much time on their phones and forget how to talk face to face. If this trend continues, our social skills will become weaker.
accepted: Nowadays, technology has changed the way we communicate. In the past, people wrote letters, which took many days to arrive. Now, however, we can send a message in a second. Although this is convenient, it also has some negative effects. For example, many young people spend too much time on their phones and forget how to talk face to face. If this trend continues, our social skills will become weaker.
items.reason: Agreement: have→has, can sends→send, have→has, spends→spend, forgets→forget, skill→skills। Tense: “was writing”→“wrote” (अतीतको बानी), “take”→“took”। Structure: “Although … but” double connector हो - “but” हटाउनुहोस्। Conditional: “if … continue … will became”→“continues … will become” (will पछि base verb)। Plural/article: effect→effects, phone→phones।

items.prompt: EDIT ESSAY 3. Correct every error. “Pollution is one of the most serious problem in the world today. The main cause of it are the vehicles and the factories. In big cities, the air quality have become very poor, and many people suffers from breathing disease. Government should took strong action. If they had acted earlier, the situation would not be so bad now. It is high time we do something about this issue.”
items.answer: Pollution is one of the most serious problems in the world today. The main causes of it are vehicles and factories. In big cities, air quality has become very poor, and many people suffer from breathing diseases. Governments should take strong action. If they had acted earlier, the situation would not be so bad now. It is high time we did something about this issue.
accepted: Pollution is one of the most serious problems in the world today. The main causes of it are vehicles and factories. In big cities, air quality has become very poor, and many people suffer from breathing diseases. Governments should take strong action. If they had acted earlier, the situation would not be so bad now. It is high time we did something about this issue.
items.reason: Agreement: problem→problems (“one of the most” पछि), cause … are→causes are, have become→has become (subject “quality”), suffers→suffer, disease→diseases। Verb form: “should took”→“should take”। Article: “the vehicles and the factories”→सामान्य अर्थमा “vehicles and factories”; “Government”→“Governments”। Mixed conditional पहिले नै सही छ (“had acted … would not be … now”)। “It is high time” पछि past subjunctive आउँछ: “we did,” “we do” होइन।

items.prompt: EDIT ESSAY 4 (lightly flawed). Correct every error. “There is many reasons why people choose to live in cities. Firstly, cities offers more job opportunities than rural areas. Secondly, the access to good education and healthcare are better. However, urban life also have its drawbacks, such as pollution and high cost of living. Despite of these problems, the majority of people still prefers city life.”
items.answer: There are many reasons why people choose to live in cities. Firstly, cities offer more job opportunities than rural areas. Secondly, access to good education and healthcare is better. However, urban life also has its drawbacks, such as pollution and a high cost of living. Despite these problems, the majority of people still prefer city life.
accepted: There are many reasons why people choose to live in cities. Firstly, cities offer more job opportunities than rural areas. Secondly, access to good education and healthcare is better. However, urban life also has its drawbacks, such as pollution and a high cost of living. Despite these problems, the majority of people still prefer city life.
items.reason: Agreement: “There is many”→“There are many,” offers→offer, “access … are”→“access … is” (subject “access” हो, singular), have→has, prefers→prefer (यहाँ subject “majority of people”-लाई plural मानिएको छ)। Preposition: “Despite of”→“Despite” (“of” आउँदैन)। Article: “a high cost of living”।

items.prompt: EDIT ESSAY 5 (subtle errors + one range upgrade). Correct the errors, then add ONE high-band structure (an inversion, a cleft, or a nominalisation) where it fits. “Renewable energy has become more important in recent years. Many governments have invested in solar and wind power because they want to reduce their dependence on fossil fuels. This is a positive development, but it is also expensive. Not only it reduces emissions, it also creates jobs. The transition will take time, but it is necessary.”
items.answer: Renewable energy has become increasingly important in recent years. Many governments have invested in solar and wind power because they want to reduce their dependence on fossil fuels. This shift is a positive development, though a costly one. Not only does it reduce emissions, but it also creates jobs. The transition to clean energy will take time, but it is necessary.
accepted: Renewable energy has become increasingly important in recent years. Many governments have invested in solar and wind power because they want to reduce their dependence on fossil fuels. This shift is a positive development, though a costly one. Not only does it reduce emissions, but it also creates jobs. The transition to clean energy will take time, but it is necessary.
items.reason: मूल लेखाइ लगभग शुद्ध छ; मुख्य सुधार inversion हो: “Not only it reduces”→“Not only does it reduce …, but it also creates” (अगाडि ल्याइएको “not only” पछि question word order)। देखाइएका ऐच्छिक upgrade: register-का लागि “increasingly important,” nominalised cohesive subject-को रूपमा “This shift,” र density-का लागि “the transition to clean energy”।

blocks: Speaking-को पनि Writing जस्तै उही Grammatical Range and Accuracy criterion-मा मूल्याङ्कन हुन्छ, तर लक्ष्य फरक हुन्छ: real time-मा नियन्त्रित लचकता, लेखाइ जस्तो बाक्लो संरचना होइन। पहिले आधारभूत शुद्धता ठीक गर्नुहोस्, अनि एउटा complex sentence र एउटा tense contrast थप्नुहोस्।
**किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ:** परीक्षार्थीहरू प्रायः Writing-को grammar-का लागि चाहिनेभन्दा बढी तयारी गर्छन्, तर Speaking-मा उही criterion-का लागि कम तयारी गर्छन्, जहाँ लक्ष्य फरक हुन्छ।
Speaking-का लागि upgrade toolkit, महत्त्वको क्रममा
1. **पहिले आधारभूत शुद्धता ठीक गर्नुहोस्** -- agreement, tense र article, किनभने यिनैमा सबैभन्दा धेरै अंक काटिन्छ।
2. **एउटा complex sentence थप्नुहोस्** -- दुई वटा विचार जोड्न एउटा because, although वा which clause।
3. **एउटा tense contrast थप्नुहोस्** -- range देखाउन past, present र future बीच आवतजावत गर्नुहोस्: I used to..., but now I...
शुद्ध, लचिलो spoken English -- घोकेको paragraph होइन। Part 2 answer-मा एउटा स्वाभाविक complex sentence र एउटा tense contrast-ले तपाईंको score-का लागि घोकेको idiom भन्दा धेरै काम गर्छ।

blocks.title: Exercise 10.2 · Speaking Transcript Polish
blocks.instructions: ५ वटा basic-but-safe spoken answer। आधारभूत शुद्धता ठीक गरेर र एउटा complex sentence, एउटा tense contrast र एउटा hedging phrase थपेर हरेकलाई एक band माथि उठाउनुहोस्, तर scripted नसुनियोस्।

items.prompt: SPEAKING POLISH 1. Raise this Part 1 answer one band, keeping it natural. “Yes, I like reading. I read many book. My favourite is story book. I read every day because it is relaxing.”
items.answer: Yes, I really enjoy reading. I read a lot of books, and my favourite genre is fiction. I try to read every day because I find it relaxing, and I'd say it's the best way for me to unwind after work.
accepted: Yes, I really enjoy reading. I read a lot of books, and my favourite genre is fiction. I try to read every day because I find it relaxing, and I'd say it's the best way for me to unwind after work.
items.reason: सुधार: “many book”→“a lot of books,” “story book”→“fiction”। Range थप्ने: एउटा because clause, एउटा hedging phrase (“I'd say”), र cleft जस्तो जोड (“it's the best way … to unwind”), साथै tense/register-मा सुधार।

items.prompt: SPEAKING POLISH 2. Raise this Part 1 answer one band. “I live in Dhaka. It is big city. There is many people. I like it because my family is here.”
items.answer: I live in Dhaka, which is a very large and crowded city. Although there are a lot of people and the traffic can be difficult, I really like living here because my whole family is nearby.
accepted: I live in Dhaka, which is a very large and crowded city. Although there are a lot of people and the traffic can be difficult, I really like living here because my whole family is nearby.
items.reason: सुधार: “big city”→“a very large … city,” “There is many”→“there are a lot of”। Range थप्ने: एउटा relative clause (“which is …”), एउटा contrast clause (“Although …”), र एउटा reason clause (“because …”)।

items.prompt: SPEAKING POLISH 3. Raise this Part 2 answer one band. “I want to talk about my phone. I use it every day. It is very useful. I use it for call and internet. I cannot live without it.”
items.answer: The possession I'd like to talk about is my phone, which I use constantly throughout the day. I rely on it for almost everything, from making calls to browsing the internet, and honestly I'm not sure how I'd manage without it now.
accepted: The possession I'd like to talk about is my phone, which I use constantly throughout the day. I rely on it for almost everything, from making calls to browsing the internet, and honestly I'm not sure how I'd manage without it now.
items.reason: सुधार: “for call”→“for making calls”। Range थप्ने: एउटा cleft opener (“The possession I'd like to talk about is …”), एउटा relative clause, एउटा hedging phrase (“honestly … I'm not sure”), र conditional-को स्पर्श (“how I'd manage without it”)।

items.prompt: SPEAKING POLISH 4. Raise this Part 3 answer one band. “Yes, technology changed our life. Before, people did everything by hand. Now, machine do the work. I think it is good.”
items.answer: Yes, technology has changed our lives enormously. Whereas people used to do almost everything by hand, machines now handle much of the work, which has made life far more efficient. On the whole, I'd say the change has been positive, though it does have some downsides.
accepted: Yes, technology has changed our lives enormously. Whereas people used to do almost everything by hand, machines now handle much of the work, which has made life far more efficient. On the whole, I'd say the change has been positive, though it does have some downsides.
items.reason: सुधार: “changed”→“has changed,” “life”→“lives,” “machine do”→“machines … handle”। Range थप्ने: एउटा contrast clause (“Whereas … used to …”), एउटा tense contrast (अतीतको बानी बनाम वर्तमान), hedging (“On the whole, I'd say”), र एउटा concession (“though it does have …”)।

items.prompt: SPEAKING POLISH 5. Raise this Part 3 answer one band. “Government should help poor people. They can give money and job. If they do this, poverty will reduce.”
items.answer: I think governments have a real responsibility to support people living in poverty, for instance by providing financial assistance and creating job opportunities. If such measures were implemented effectively, poverty would be likely to fall, although it clearly cannot be solved overnight.
accepted: I think governments have a real responsibility to support people living in poverty, for instance by providing financial assistance and creating job opportunities. If such measures were implemented effectively, poverty would be likely to fall, although it clearly cannot be solved overnight.
items.reason: सुधार: “Government”→“governments,” “poor people”→“people living in poverty,” “give money and job”→“providing financial assistance and creating job opportunities”। Range थप्ने: एउटा second conditional (“If … were implemented … would be likely to fall”), hedging (“be likely to”), र एउटा concession clause।

g11_review.title: 11. Answer Key, Diagnostic Index र Exam Routine
blocks: नयाँ drill होइन, यो एउटा consolidation reference हो: गलत उत्तरलाई कसरी review गर्ने, सबैभन्दा धेरै हुने गल्तीहरूको diagnostic index र हरेकलाई सच्याउने एउटै नियम, पूरा अध्याय-नक्सा, र परीक्षाको १० मिनेटको self-edit routine।

यो course-को हरेक exercise आफैं जाँच हुन्छ: तपाईंले उत्तर बुझाउनासाथ platform-ले सही version, त्यो किन सही हो भन्ने कारण, र मूल नियम बुझाउने एउटा नेपाली नोट देखाउँछ। यो अन्तिम अध्याय अर्को drill-को सेट होइन। यो एउटा consolidation reference हो - कुनै गल्ती बारम्बार दोहोरिँदा यहाँ फर्केर आउनुहोस्, ताकि गल्तीहरूको पूरै परिवारलाई सच्याउने त्यो एउटा नियम भेट्टाउन सक्नुहुन्छ। यसलाई diagnostic index-को रूपमा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्: तपाईंले बारम्बार गर्ने गल्ती पहिचान गर्नुहोस्, त्यसपछि नियम र त्यो नियम आएको अध्याय फेरि पढ्नुहोस्।
कुनै item गलत भयो भने सही उत्तर मात्र पढेर अगाडि नबढ्नुहोस्। ३० सेकेन्ड लगाएर गल्तीको कारण पत्ता लगाउनुहोस्, किनकि त्यही किसिमको गल्ती तपाईंको आफ्नै लेखाइमा फेरि आउँछ।
Model answer र reason सँगै पढ्नुहोस्, ताकि सच्याइएको रूप मात्र होइन, नियमले कसरी काम गर्छ त्यो पनि देख्न सक्नुहुन्छ।
गल्तीको किसिमको नाम दिनुहोस्: यो agreement, tense, article, preposition, structure, कि range-को समस्या हो?
त्यो किसिमको मूल अध्यायमा फर्कनुहोस् (नक्सा 11.3-मा छ) र त्यसलाई नियन्त्रण गर्ने त्यो एउटा नियम फेरि पढ्नुहोस्।
नियमलाई सही तरिकाले प्रयोग गरेर आफैं २ वटा नयाँ वाक्य लेख्नुहोस्। चिन्न सक्नु मात्र होइन, आफैं त्यो रूप बनाउन सक्नुले नै त्यसलाई तपाईंको active grammar-मा ल्याउँछ।
11.2 सबैभन्दा धेरै हुने गल्ती, र हरेकलाई सच्याउने एउटै नियम
बंगलादेशी परीक्षार्थीहरूको लेखाइमा सबैभन्दा धेरै देखिने गल्तीहरू यिनै हुन्। यो सानो table राम्ररी आत्मसात् गर्नुभयो भने तपाईंका बारम्बार हुने गल्तीहरूमध्ये धेरैजसो हट्छन्।
Verb नजिकको noun-सँग होइन, साँचो subject-सँग मिल्छ।
Uncountable noun-मा a/an लाग्दैन, plural पनि हुँदैन।
एउटै मात्र हुने (unique) कुराको अगाडि ‘the’ लाग्छ।
सकिइसकेको वर्षका लागि past simple चाहिन्छ, present perfect होइन।
‘Since/for’-सँग perfect tense आउँछ, present continuous होइन।

परीक्षाको दिन, तपाईंले बनाएको grammar तब मात्र काम लाग्छ जब self-edit गर्न समय छुट्याउनुहुन्छ। हरेक writing task-को अन्तिम केही मिनेट लक्षित review-का लागि राख्नुहोस्, र अध्याय १०-का pass-हरू क्रमैसँग चलाउनुहोस्।

Task 1 (~३ मिनेट छुट्याउनुहोस्): हरेक tense data-को time frame-सँग मिल्छ कि मिल्दैन जाँच्नुहोस्; data preposition (by, from, to, of) जाँच्नुहोस्; “the number of” र “the proportion of” पछि singular verb आएको छ कि छैन जाँच्नुहोस्।

Task 2 (~५ मिनेट छुट्याउनुहोस्): agreement, article र preposition pass चलाउनुहोस्; कुनै if-clause-मा “will” छैन भनेर पक्का गर्नुहोस्; विभिन्न किसिमका complex sentence र कम्तीमा एउटा सफा high-band structure छ भनेर पक्का गर्नुहोस्।
Speaking (real time-मा): agreement वा tense-को कुनै slip सुन्नुभयो भने सहज रूपमा self-correct गरेर अगाडि बढ्नुहोस्; सफा self-correction नियन्त्रणको संकेत हो, कमजोरीको होइन।

कुनै नियम जान्नु र दबाबमा त्यसलाई प्रयोग गर्नु २ वटा फरक सीप हुन्, र यी दुईबीचको खाडल यो अध्यायमा बताइएको review-को बानीले मात्र पुरिन्छ। आफ्ना बारम्बार हुने गल्तीको कारण पत्ता लगाउने, मूल नियममा फर्कने, र त्यसपछि आफैं नयाँ सही उदाहरण बनाउने परीक्षार्थीहरू drill एकपटक मात्र पूरा गर्नेहरूभन्दा धेरै छिटो सुधार गर्छन्। यो course-को हरेक गलत उत्तरलाई कुन एउटा नियम फेरि हेर्ने भन्ने जानकारीको रूपमा लिनुहोस्। गल्तीबाट नियम, नियमबाट नयाँ प्रयोग - यही loop-ले पढाइलाई उच्च band-मा बदल्छ।

Review loop: गलत उत्तर → गल्तीको किसिमको नाम दिनुहोस् → नियम फेरि पढ्नुहोस् → आफैं २ वटा सही वाक्य लेख्नुहोस्।
Exam routine: अन्तिम केही मिनेट सधैं ६ वटा editing pass क्रमैसँग चलाउनका लागि छुट्याउनुहोस्।
